fixed_blocker.defect: Inherited source rollback accepted equal postimage bytes on a different, unowned inode and overwrote that inode.
fixed_blocker.fix: BindingTransaction pins three staged source identities, verifies staged/prepared ownership, and uses an owned source restore loop with dev/ino/uid/gid/mode/size+bytes checks before each restore. Successful lifecycle base dff6 remains byte-identical.

independent_review: Six embedded module bodies and every SHA/size guard equal the final immutable manifest. The complete wrapper equals the expected deterministic template; only the main installer module changed after the reviewed initial bundle.

All three exact source transforms compile and reverse to original bytes. Menu change appends one existing overlay tuple; identity route preserves ordinary tool loop. No application module or payload was executed.

Five-file scope is exact: three existing sources require pinned before/after bytes; helper and snapshot require absence and atomic no-clobber os.link creation. Existing unexpected targets are neither adopted nor overwritten.

New-file ownership follows the exact staged inode including partial link/unlink states. Rollback removes only new paths whose bytes/dev/inode/owner/mode still match the transaction; new hardlinks require matching staged identity.
Fixed source rollback checks its recorded staged/postimage identity both before preparing a restore and immediately before replacement. Equal bytes on another inode now HOLD without overwriting it.

Existing maintenance lock pin, global STOP guards, fresh IDLE status and free 8098 slots remain. Pre-stop Supervisor identity must match pinned PID3550426/start174075151/argv and config; stop/start scope is only nox-proxy.

Existing recovery keeps old and newly observed proxy lifetimes, rejects unknown startup identity, requires known lifetimes dead before restoration/start, and preserves global STOP. Old base dff6 is unchanged.

Model restart, model POST, S03/history/queue/counter reset and permission widening are outside this transaction. Public output redacts Supervisor command/environment values; only bounded metadata/hash receipts are exposed.

Final installed status requires all three postimage hashes plus both exact new artifacts with single link,0600 and expected ownership. A mixed or unreadable state is UNKNOWN; completed cannot stay true when final five-file readback fails.

independent_dynamic_validation.case: Replace a successfully installed source with equal bytes on a foreign inode, then rollback: HOLD and foreign inode/body preserved.

limits_and_followup: Source/build approval does not prove native installation, fresh server pins or active loaded-module identity.

Owner idle and slot checks are bounded observations, not an atomic lock against a newly arriving chat. Coordinator must provide the existing authorized quiet maintenance window and one unique dispatch intent.
The inherited process identity reader reads bounded environ locally for Supervisor service identity; values are never exported. No credential extraction/transfer is added.
Filesystem CAS relies on the existing cooperating maintenance lock; the review does not claim protection against arbitrary concurrent privileged writers between check and rename.
Lost filesystem effects may leave a conservative HOLD/manual-readback state. Do not replay the wrapper or treat a failed receipt as absence of effects.
Changed-path QA must still confirm model question SSE, actual prefix fit, ordinary tool path, preserved conversation/history and the repaired menu URL after coordinated loading.
